Braised Chicken Legs with Rice, Potatoes & Veggies🍗 Ingredients * 1 package chicken drumsticks (6–7 pieces) * 1-2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp salt * 1 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp garlic powder * 2 tsp onion powder * 2 tsp paprika * ½ tsp cumin * 1 jalapeño, diced * ½ red onion, diced * 1 tbsp sun-dried tomato paste * 1 tbsp @Loisa sofrito * 5–6 garlic cloves, minced * 4 cups chicken stock * 1 (8 oz) can tomato sauce * Small potatoes, halved (about 10–12 baby potatoes) * 1 zucchini, diced * Cooked white rice, for serving (let me know if you guys want my rice recipe) Instructions: 1. Clean the chicken with vinegar, then pat completely dry with paper towels. 2. Season the chicken with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and cumin. Toss until evenly coated. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven or deep skillet over medium-high heat. 4. Brown the chicken for 2–3 minutes per side until golden. It doesn’t need to be cooked through. Remove and set aside. 5. In the same pot, add the diced jalapeño and red onion. Cook for about 5 minutes until softened. 6. Stir in the sun-dried tomato paste and cook for 30 seconds. 7. Add the Loisa Sofrito and minced garlic. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant. 8. Pour in the chicken stock and tomato sauce, stirring to combine. Bring to a gentle boil. 9. Return the chicken to the pot. Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for about 1 hour, or until the chicken is fall-apart tender and the sauce has reduced. 10. About 20 minutes before the chicken is done, add the halved potatoes and diced zucchini. Continue simmering until the potatoes are fork-tender and the zucchini is cooked. 11. Serve over fluffy white rice and spoon plenty of the sauce over the top. #chickenlegs #braised #onepotmeals #cookwithme

Kinder cookie bars recipe 🤎✨   Ingredients: * 275g plain flour * 1 tsp bicarbonate of soda * 1 tbsp cornflour * 1/2 tsp salt * 115g unsalted butter * 55g granulated sugar * 135g light brown sugar * 1 medium egg * 1 tsp vanilla * 100g milk chocolate * 150g Kinder chocolate Method 1. Preheat oven to 190°C (170°C fan) and line a 9x9 inch tin. 2. Mix the flour, bicarbonate of soda, cornflour and salt in a bowl. 3. Melt the butter, then mix with both sugars. 4. Add the egg and vanilla and mix together. 5. Add the dry ingredients and mix into a thick dough. 6. Stir in the milk chocolate and Kinder chocolate. 7. Press the mixture into the tin and add extra Kinder on top. 8. Bake for 17–22 minutes. 9. Leave to cool before cutting into bars.                                                          You can also find the recipe on @janespatisserie page!                                                        #cookie #kinder #baking #fyp #viral

alt makeup!!! #alt #makeup #altmakeup #xoxo  Ryuk is a Shinigami (God of Death) from the world of the Shinigami in the series Death Note. Unlike most Shinigami, who spend their time quietly extending their own lifespans by taking human lives, Ryuk becomes incredibly bored with his existence. Seeking entertainment, he intentionally drops a Death Note—a supernatural notebook that can kill anyone whose name is written in it—into the human world. The notebook is found by Light Yagami, a brilliant high school student. Ryuk then follows Light and watches as he begins using the Death Note to kill criminals and create a world free of crime. Throughout the story, Ryuk acts more like an observer than a participant. He does not help Light achieve his goals, nor does he actively try to stop him. Instead, he watches the events unfold because he finds them entertaining. Ryuk is known for his frightening appearance, dark sense of humor, and obsession with apples, which he considers a rare treat from the human world. Although he often laughs at human behavior and enjoys chaos, he is generally honest about his intentions and never pretends to be something he isn't. One of Ryuk's defining characteristics is his neutrality. He repeatedly reminds Light that he is not his friend and that he is simply watching the story for his own amusement. In fact, Ryuk tells Light from the beginning that when the time comes, he will be the one to write Light's name in the Death Note. At his core, Ryuk serves as the catalyst for the entire story. Without him dropping the Death Note into the human world, the events of Death Note would never have happened. He represents curiosity, boredom, and the unpredictable consequences that can occur when immense power is placed in human hands.

“But she’s just a corgi…”  Meet Maple the 4 year old Corgi.  Sweet in the right moments… but dangerous in the wrong ones. Resource guarding food and household items. Multiple bites on owners and family members. Reactive to other dogs on walks, barking & lunging. And now there’s a baby in the home. During the evaluation, Maple tried to bite me multiple times. Not because she’s a “bad dog”… But because she’s been making decisions for a long time without clear direction. No real structure. No consistent boundaries. No clear communication or expectations. And when you let “dogs be dogs” they do just that.  This is the part people struggle with.. You can love your dog deeply and still be missing the leadership they actually need. Honest question… Do you think dogs like Maple know they’re doing something wrong… or are they just doing what’s always worked for them? #DogTraining #dogtrainer #dogsoftiktok #dogs #dog
